title: Cost attribution finds a change only under .worktrees/…
what: lib/relay_estimate.py:19: MEDIUM: F3 cost attribution finds a change only under .worktrees/, so lane agents in a .worktree project (ALIX) count for no change
why: 29 Oct, review of the lane-start worktree-folder fix, outside that change: the worktree-folder rule lives in several copies; cost attribution misses ALIX's lanes. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: An agent of an ALIX lane works in /x/alix/.worktree/fx/lib, or its brief says "Worktree: /x/alix/.worktree/fx (branch wt/fx)".

Now: relay_estimate.worktree_of('/x/alix/.worktree/fx/lib') -> None; change_of('/x/alix', 'Worktree: /x/alix/.worktree/fx (branch wt/fx)') -> None; queue_ext/estimate.repo_top keeps the worktree as the repo.
